title: Approvals shows one list at a time, in tabs
description: Approvals stacked up to three lists on one page, and everything under the first was easy to miss. Each list is now a tab with its count, and the page opens on whatever is waiting on you.
items: Team leaders and the manager: Waiting on me, Timesheet weeks (manager only) and My requests
Admin, business manager and CEO: Requests and Timesheet weeks
Holidays & events uses the same tabs
